title: Roll No. 21
description: Kris is an intelligent and naughty kid who stays at an orphanage along with his friends, Pinky and Bablu. An Evil demon King, posing as principal Kanishk is out to create havoc in the school. He has an ulterior motive of taking over the world with his army of zombie demons. To save his friends and the school from annihilation, Kris prays to Lord Krishna and is blessed with super powers.

episodes.title: S1-E11PINKY Ki Chhaya (What's Up With PINKY)
S1-E13Mathura High vs Lok Paataal Low
S2-E11Hum Mein Hain Dum (FIgth for right)

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x1
episodes_data.description: Its raining bugs at school. There are bugs all around. In the shower, in Kanishk's coffee, in Suparna's make up kit etc. And none other that Vrishchika - the scorpion lady from netherworld is responsible for this. She's come seeking revenge from Kris. Meanwhile Dr. J gives the kids a an assignment to collect the highest number of bugs.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x2
episodes_data.description: Madhu the geek creates his virtual alter ego, called Maddy, on a networking website. Its way of becoming a popular kid in class. Maddy is everything that Madhu had always wanted to be but cannot. Maddy is not a geek, looks suave, he is funny, he is a hero. Maddy has become the talk of the school. Dr. J hatches a plan to use Maddy to defeat Kris.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x3
episodes_data.description: A knock on the head, makes Kanishk lose his memory and he thinks that Kris in his best friend rather than his sworn enemy. He doesn't even remember that he's the school principal anymore. Kanishk begins acting like a kid and sticks to Kris like glue. Though it is fun at first, Kris soon becomes bored…no enemy, no Kanishk equals to zero fun.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x4
episodes_data.description: Kris has been behaving strange at school. He paints a moustache on Pinky's doll's face. Kris helps Golu bullBablu much to the surprise of both of them... Madhu's specs are missing and Kris makes fun of him... Kris trips Sukhi as he is raking the leaves... Everyone hates the way Kris is behaving and can't figure out why? Actually , this is Tarak and Kanishk's evil plan.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x5
episodes_data.description: Pinky wants to keep a pet puppy. But Kanishk would allow that at all, he hates animals and animals hate him !! Kris gets an idea to make his friends' wish come true and also an opportunity to stoke the fire of Kanishk's wrath at the same time. Kris puts up a sign outside the ashram, “Free Pet Wash” and within no time, the ashram is filled with pets from all around Mathura.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x6
episodes_data.description: Its Bablu's birthday and the kids are preparing for a surprise birthday party. Kanishk has got a whiff of the surprise birthday plans and is plotting to make Bablu's birthday alsos Kris' last day on earth. To ruin the birthday plans and to get rid of Kris, Bun Bun mausi (demon spider) is called from the netherworld.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x7
episodes_data.description: Kanishk has summoned Kaka/Bhusasur (The scary scarecrow) again to handle Kris and his friends. While Kanishk, Bhusasur and the 3 minions get ready for Kris, the kids are having fun playing a game of witch and wizards in the dorm. Golu dares Kris to sneak into the Principals office. Dr. J had bribed Golu with chociolates earlier to make him get Kris to the office.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x8
episodes_data.description: Kanishk's failure to defeat Kris has brought shame to his family in the netherworld. So this time his mom, dad and grandfather pay Kanishk a visit. They feel that Kanishk needs to brush up his evil demon skills and so appoint a teacher for him and the minions. the teacher is a magical stick and it'll train Kanishk and the minions to be the most horrible demons who can crush Kris like a fly.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x9
episodes_data.description: Yogachari arrives again from the netherworld to take revenge against Kris. He works his magic on the kids due to which the kids cannot sleep at night. The next morning when the kids are noddig off in class the 3 minions keep them awake in one pretext or the other. Slowly the sleep deprived kids begin to hallucinate. Yogachari uses the kids' deepest desires and make them turn against the kids.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x10
episodes_data.description: Fed up of Golu's constant bullying, Madhu makes a bully-proof helmet. The helmet can use the opponents powers against him. So the next time Golu tries to Bully or hit anyone Madhu uses the helmet and Golu ends up hitting his ownself. Dr.J steals Madhu's helmet and shows it to Kanishk.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x11
episodes_data.description: Kanishk plans to attack Kris with the help of someone he least expects. What better than hypnotizing one of his best friends – Pinky! Kanishk's minion Chhaya Maya has come back and has worked her magic on Pinky. Pinky is no longer her usual self. She has been behaving a little weird off late. The evil Pinky lures Kris with butter, takes him to remote places on the pretext of finding her doll etc

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x12
episodes_data.description: For the 'Show and Tell' assignment, Bablu gets his hands on an ancient armor. But little does he know that the armor actually belongs to the netherworld and it was Kanishk's plan all along to make Bablu 'find' the armor. Once Bablu wears the evil armor, he feels and becomes all powerful. He even takes on the class bully Golu in a fight. Bablu's armor is a hit at the show and tell.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x13
episodes_data.description: At Mathura Anath Aashram holidays have been declared. This means no classes, no studies, no books for a whole week! Kanishka however is sad as this also means he can't summon any demons from the netherworld in the disguise of teachers. But Kanishk has another plan ready. The Lokpaatal school (in the netehrworld) is also on a break.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x14
episodes_data.description: Kanishk notices the uncanny resemblance between Besurdas, the demon musician and Vasudev, the school's PT teacher. Kanishk gets an idea to do away with kris. He decides to replace Vasudev wjth Besurdas. This way getting Kris would be a piece of cake. Vasudev is locked up in a cupboard and Besurdas takes his place as the PT teacher.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x15
episodes_data.description: The Gods are pretty upset with Kris as his pranks are rising and since his arrival on earth he has displayed no interest in studies. Instantly a message is sent across through Narad that in the upcoming exams Kris must secure an A grade in at least one subject or else he'll be punished by the Big Gods...and the butter supply will be stopped! Now, Kris has no option to score in his studies.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x16
episodes_data.description: The minions Dr. J, Suparna, and Tarak, have had enough. They are fed up of always being at the receiving end of Kansa's wrath. They say that the conditions of work are appalling (as they have to suffer bratty kids like Golu), apart from the regular beating they receive from Kris, they don't even have a decent salary and there are no perks.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x17
episodes_data.description: Golu finds a strange looking fly in a pond near the school. What he assumes is a fly is actually the alien from a previous episode. The Alien has come back to take revenge from krishna. Since its last encounter with Kris some internal circuitry of the Alien has gone bad and it goes berserk whenever it sees the color blue.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x18
episodes_data.description: Kanishk gets Dr. J to steal Queen Moongila's diamond studded tiara and hide it in a safe place. Kanishk plans to blame Kris for the missing tiara. Queen Moongila, finds a peacock feather near place where she kept her tiara. Kanishk identifies it as Kris's feather. The Queen boils with anger and says she'll not rest till she takes back her tiara from Kris.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x19
episodes_data.description: In this episode Kanishk once again tries to show that he's one up that Kris. But his jealosy take the better of him. Its Super Hero day at the Aashram and all students and teachers have to dress up as their favorite Superhero. Some fictitious super heroes like Monkey man, Eggman, Suparna dresses up as Powder-puff girl, Tarak as Wind Man. Kanishk practices by dressing up a 'Duck Man'.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x20
episodes_data.description: It's a science fair / competition is being held in school this time. But this is competition is different as along with the kids the teachers will also participate. This brilliant idea was of course given by Dr. J who had been bragging about his laudable scientific achievements. Kanishk is fed up with Dr. J's constant brag talk, especially when every gadgets of his has failed to get rid of Kris.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x21
episodes_data.description: All the kids of Mathura High have behaved themselves and as a reward are being taken to a fair. Kids are happy with all the food, rides and games on display. Especially Golu who has so much scope to flaunt... he hogs, jumps the queues, cheats and finally manages to win a special ‘toy' on display. It is a puppet that Golu names ‘gudda'.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x22
episodes_data.description: All the teachers of Mathura Anath Ashram are on a self implied leave. Kanishk is now left to run the whole school all by himself. Kanishk falls flat on his face while trying to do so. This is when J presents his latest invention to Kanishk; a copying machine, which can create copies of ANYTHING.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 1x23
episodes_data.description: Dr.J was working on his new invention and he accidentally zaps Kanishk and turns him into a 10 year old boy. A t first Kanishk is mad but Dr.J tells him that as a boy he can get rid of Kris much more easily. So Kanishk comes to Kris's class as a new student - KUKU. Kuku acts sweet and innocent and the students instantly take a liking for him.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x1
episodes_data.description: After being constantly battered and bashed by Kris, Kanishk finally realizes that he will never win any battle with Kris. This depresses him and he decides to leave Mathura to become a hermit. The news spreads in the school like a wild fire. Then starts a power struggle between J, Taarak and Suparna, while the kids are happy and chilling out (as there are no classes anymore).

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x2
episodes_data.description: This episode begin with a battle between Kris and Kanishk. five demons from Netherworld - BHUSASUR, FUNTOOSH, BAANKE, CHHAYA MAYA and BUN BUN MAUSI are also fighting with Kris. Finally Kanishk manages to throw kris down the cliff and it seems that Finally Kanishk has managed to get rid of Kris. For the first time when the roll call happens we hear 'Roll NO 21 - ABSENT SIR' instead of Present Sir

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x3
episodes_data.description: Kanishk calls Kris' elder brother Balram aka Ballu to keep a tab on Kris' magic (because Ballu wont let Kris use any magic in the real world). Kris is happy to see his brother but is also stressed because of Ballu's restrictions over him. Now Ballu becomes the coolest kid in the school, making Kris feel sidelined and dejected.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x4
episodes_data.description: A lucky draw is announced and few lucky kids (5) will get to go to a magic land! Everyone is thrilled and the lucky kids are Kris, Pinky, Bablu, Madhu and Prashant. But Golu bullies Prashant and snatches his ticket from him to be the 5th kid to go to Magic land. Sukhi too accompanies the kids. We see a big yellow bus which is actually a teleporting device designed by J to take them to Patal Nagri

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x5
episodes_data.description: Kanishk's schoolmate and rival SHAKUN shows up to boast about his school KAURAV PUBLIC SCHOOL (KPS) and its excellent students. An embarassed Kanishk retorts back and they both decide to settle it in a inter school sports meet. Kanishk announces the sports event in his school but keeps Kris out of the practice sessions, because he doesnt want Kris to mess up anything for him.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x6
episodes_data.description: A new candy seller has set up shop outside the school. His candies are a hit as the candy wrappers have stick-on tattoos inside. The tatoos have become a real hit with the kids as well as the teachers. Kris is not really interested in the tattoos, he just wants the candies and gives the tattoos to his friends. Kanishk is pretty upset with all the fuss about some 'stupid tattoos'.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x7
episodes_data.description: Ballu makes a comeback in this story, as he feels that his brother is not safe in the school. What starts as a fun reunion turns into an anoying restriction for Kris. Because Ballu wont let anyone or anything to come even near Kris. Even Taarak, J and Kanishk face the wrath of Ballu when they try to intervene.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x8
episodes_data.description: In a basketball match when Kris stands up in defence of Pinky when Golu trips her. Golu teases Pinky by saying that girls cant stand up for themselves. Pinky feels insulted and angry. She challenges Golu that she'll prove that girls are equally capable. This starts off a tiff between Pinky and Kris too, and Kris gets drawn into the whole girls vs boys fight.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x9
episodes_data.description: Suffering from severe cold Taarak tries to get a leave, but Kanishk instead forces him to take extra classes. Dr.J out of (fake) compassion makes a potion to cure Taarak's cold. But the potion backfires and turns Taarak into a fire sneezer. Now Taarak is sneezing fire and destroying everything around him (kids' homework, school property, Kanishk's office).

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x10
episodes_data.description: An Alien Ship lands in Mathura. Alien No:21 is leading the alien mission. The mission is to defeat Kanishk, capture Mathura and the blue boy Kris. The Aliens make their way into the school and take over the bodies of Golu and some other students. The kids begin acting weird. Their eyes glow red and they are super strong, lifting and throwing things around.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x11
episodes_data.description: Kids are tired of eating the mucky food in the cafeteria, so they take the matter to Kanishk. But Kanishk turns a deaf ear on their plea and so Madhu decides to go on a strike. Kris and other kids support him. This is when the kids get to know that the teachers have a secret stash of delicious food for them.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x12
episodes_data.description: its time for the annual picnic and kanishk hates doing all the preparations for it.But he gets a little help when Vrishchika- the scorpion demon arrives. All she wants in return is that Kanishk should lead Kris to a lonely spot in the jungle so that she can take her revenge. Kanishk, Dr.J and the children head out for the picnin.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x13
episodes_data.description: Kanishk is threatened by his staff to either release their salaries or accept their resignation. Kanishk doesnt want to pay anything to anyone, so he is looking for a way out. Soon he introduces his own currency in MAA, which is caled 'DHINGA-CHIKA'. Now Dhinga Chika is the official currency at MAA. All the kids are being fined and rewarded with dhinga chika by the teachers.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x14
episodes_data.description: Dr.J makes a cross-connection radio, to eavesdrop on people's telephonic conversations. Through his cross connection device he hears that Sukhi and his Himalayan Guru's conversation. The himalayan Guru's house is being sprayed with pesticide so the guru decides to send all the food and the Magic Honey to Sukhi's phone booth.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x15
episodes_data.description: Golu is extorting money out of the kids from school to secure his future. On the other hand, fed up of his failed experiments, Kanishk kicks J out of his school. Same day, a battered Kanishk appears in front of Kanishk who tells him that he is the Kanishk from future. Future Kanishk further explains that J has become the mayor of Mathura in and taking his revenge on Kanishk in the future.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x16
episodes_data.description: It's Diwali time !! The festival of lights. The kids have been eagerly looking forward to the gifts they'll get this year. But Kanishk wants to ruin Diwali for Kris. He gets Dr. J to pinch Kris's gift. All the children get their gifts except for Kris. Kris is heartbroken. Kanishk rubs it in further as he shamelessly flaunts his gifts in front of Kris.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x17
episodes_data.description: In order to win Kanishk's affection, J invents a potion which would inverse the person's personality when consumed. However, it is consumed not just by Kanishk but also by Kris and gang and Golu. Now where Kanishk and Golu have turned extra nice and sweet to everyone, Kris and his gang has turned into a menace.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x18
episodes_data.description: One night Kanishk is up late watching TV when he feels like having some ice-cream. But when he goes into the school kitchen he finds the fridge empty. All the ice-cream is gone. Kris and his friends binged on all of it. Kanishk vows to never let Kris have any ice-cream ever. the next day Kanishk works his magic on Kris and puts him under a spell that'll make kris crave for ice-cream

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x19
episodes_data.description: Kris is trying to make his friends (especially Bablu) understand that believing in lucky charm and similar stuff is just a superstition, but Bablu is adamant and Golu has also joined the bandwagon. On the other hand, Kanishk has also started to believe in BABA AKHANDANAND PAAKHANDI'S TILASMI TAABEEZ, while J is trying to tell him that this is just a hokum.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x20
episodes_data.description: The children are having fun playing cricket when ball crashes through Kanishk's office and hits him on the head. Having had enough of their mischief Kanishk warns the kids to behave or else they will be sent to the detention room. Dr. J tells Kanishk that he could use this detention room idea to his benefit and get rid of Kris.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x21
episodes_data.description: Thanks to an accident caused by Kris, Kanishk gets hit in the head and gains the power to read thoughts of the people around him. This creates a mountain of problems for Kanishk's staff and Kris and other kids. Kanishk's minions are not able to curse him in their heads because Kanishk is whacking them right away and Kris is not able to win with Kanishk in any fight

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x22
episodes_data.description: It's the Annual Mathura Aashram Fest and this time a costume party has been organised . Both students and teachers will be taking part in it. The guest judge will be none other than Guru Mahasur himself. Kanishk is sick and tired of losing to Kris every time, be it the constant fights that they have or competitions that they take part in.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x23
episodes_data.description: A toothpaste company, looking for a new face of their brand is coming to MAA for the audition, and all the kids are pretty excited to be the next top model. We also get to know that Kanishk is also an aspiring actor and is desperate to get the part in the commercial. So Kanishk asks J to make sure that no kid is able to audition for the commercial.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x24
episodes_data.description: Kanishk warns Kris to up his grades in the coming exams or he will be expelled from the school. Kris who is already not interested in studies now have to shift his focus off the games and shenanigans completely. To make matters worse, Kanishk orders his minions to distract Kris from his studies and they create an attractive FUN FAIR on the MAA playground, luring Kris to them.

episodes_data.title: Roll No. 21 2x25
episodes_data.description: Mathura Anath Ashram has got a grant to install – swings and rides in the playground area. Kids are happy and so is Kanishk. Kids are simply loving it and all of them (including Golu) have become really good friends. Their love and unity baffles Kanishk (who totally dislikes Kris getting all the attention and Golu becoming friendly with Kris)
